div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
A | Receive task brief
Outcome, workspace, explicit grants, limits

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
B | Enter worker
CLI, Python SDK, or NeMo NAT wrapper

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
C | Validate TaskSpec; parse JSON grants
Defaults: 90 min, 50,000 tokens, 32 steps, 3 revisions

div.style: color: rgb(23, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
D | Create task directory
Atomic checkpoint; deliverables stay in workspace

div.style: color: rgb(23, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
E | Lock task and start ledger
One active runner per task; recorded events

div.style: color: rgb(23, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
F | Load persistent kernel
Identity, goal contract, approved memory

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
G | Ask model to plan
Budget-aware provider call; record usage and route

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
H | Normalize WorkOrder
Deliverables, requirements, assumptions, subgoals, checks

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
I | Loop budget available?
Steps, deadline, recorded model tokens

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
J | Build bounded context
Plan, tools, recent results, sources, feedback, numeric state

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
K | Ask model for one decision
Structured JSON; record usage and provider route

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
L | Valid ToolAction?
Known tool name and object arguments

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
M | Model requests finish?
May write answer.md when no artifact exists

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
N | Action allowed and ready?
Kernel allowlist, tool policy, grant, prerequisites

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
O | Execute one tool
Research, files, browser, site template, or bounded check

div.style: color: rgb(23, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
P | Persist observable outcome
Results, evidence, artifacts, interactions, numeric state

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Q | Automatic verification trigger?
Successful action plus task-specific readiness

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
R | Run mechanical verification
Files, structure, citations, HTML/browser, current interactions

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
S | Separate model review call
Brief, artifact/source excerpts, check evidence

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
T | Optional screenshot review
Eligible image route plus HTML screenshots; otherwise skip

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
U | Unresolved verification issues?
Mechanical defects or review feedback

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: V | Revision allowance remains?

div.style: color: rgb(23, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
W | Save repair feedback
Increment revision count; model chooses next repair

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
X | Finalize and reverify
Apply exact completed / partial / failed rule

div.style: color: rgb(23, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Y | If completed, stage learning candidate
Inert proposal; promotion runs separately

div.style: color: rgb(23, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Z | Return and save result
Artifacts, evidence, gaps, usage, route, audit; close tools

div.style: color: rgb(87, 52, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Invalid action
Record feedback; consumed decision step

div.style: color: rgb(87, 52, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Denied or prerequisite failure
Record error; external blocks can remain unresolved

div.style: color: rgb(87, 52, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Mechanical errors found
Skip model review for this verification cycle

div.style: color: rgb(87, 52, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Text review unavailable
Treat as unresolved issue

div.style: color: rgb(87, 52, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Provider unavailable or unusable structured reply
Save interrupted checkpoint and interrupted result

div.style: color: rgb(87, 52, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Model-call budget reservation exhausted
Stop with best current artifacts

div.style: color: rgb(87, 52, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Validation or early setup failure
Propagate error; result file not guaranteed

div.style: color: rgb(87, 52, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
KeyboardInterrupt
Save interrupted checkpoint; rethrow; resume separately

div.style: color: rgb(87, 52, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Other error inside core run
Record runtime_error; attempt finalization
